hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading (e.g., 'Production-grade, not a demo'). Max 6 words.

h1.h1: Primary service title prefix (e.g., 'LangChain development services:').
h1.span: Value proposition or core technical deliverable suffix (e.g., 'production-grade agents and RAG pipelines'). Max 6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph explaining the service value proposition, multi-step agent capabilities, and engineering reliability vs fragile demos. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Cred highlight text (e.g., '5+ yrs LangChain/LangGraph', 'Direct, no account manager', '48h architecture spec'). Max 5 words.

btn-primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Talk to a LangChain developer'). Max 4-5 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Trust note about upfront assessment and honest tool selection commitment. Exactly 1 sentence.

trust.span: Metric explanation (e.g., 'GitHub stars, LangChain', 'Integrations available', 'To a written architecture spec'). Max 5 words.
